runs.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: orthographic albedo texture-source painting for an existing 3D decoration.
Edit the FIRST image, guide_left.png, into paint_left.png: the decoration seen from its left side. Output a single 1024 x 1024 PNG with real transparent background, at the guide's original resolution and framing.

INPUT ROLES: Image 1 is the exact grey orthographic mesh render and the immutable geometry/alpha template. Image 2, design_reference.png, is the approved material and colour authority only. Image 3, concept_crop.png, is supporting original concept material reference only.

GEOMETRY LOCK: Paint directly onto image 1. Keep its alpha silhouette EXACTLY, with the same pixel outline, scale, position, tip, base, angular faceted edges, protrusions, openings and every existing shape boundary. The occupied bounding box is x=246..777 and y=66..957 on the 1024-square canvas. Do not move, enlarge, narrow, curve, smooth, rotate, mirror, crop or redesign any geometry. Preserve the exact orthographic left view, including all of its asymmetric facets. The design's three-quarter camera and additional visible towers must NOT replace the guide's geometry. Do not create cutout holes through opaque guide pixels or fill existing transparent areas. Surface lattice patterns must be painted inside the original mesh silhouette.

MATERIAL PAINT: Transfer the reference's rich black-violet organic resin lattice and subdued orange internal sacs/seams onto the mesh body; ivory bone material on the existing pointed cap and bone points. Preserve warm ivory segmented plates and their fine ochre/brown seams, rich dark purple resin with subtle natural surface variation, and faint orange interiors. The resin is a glossy material, but this image must show its diffuse base colour only. Reference-like lattice apertures within the guide's solid surface are painted colour features, not changes to the alpha mask.

LIGHTING: texture-source ALBEDO, even flat shadowless light from the viewer across every facet. No baked directional shading, no cast shadows, no ambient-occlusion darkening, no strong specular highlights or reflections, no rim light. Orange parts are painted at their glowing orange colour, with no emitted light spilling onto neighbouring surfaces, no bloom, no glow halo. Maintain material readability without lighting effects.

BACKGROUND: fully transparent alpha outside the exact original guide silhouette, including empty gaps. No floor, ground, background colour, checkerboard painted into the image, text or border. Deliver one unresized 1024 x 1024 RGBA image.
runs.reason: Rejected for corrective attempt: wrong native dimensions, changed silhouette, and baked shading/highlights.
